title: NEM Flex Telemetry Record
description: A single 5-minute interval telemetry record from a participating household. See SCHEMA.md for full specification.

interval_start_utc.description: Interval start timestamp in UTC. Format: ISO8601 with Z suffix. Interval covers [interval_start_utc, interval_start_utc + 5 minutes).

postcode_prefix.description: First 3 digits of the household postcode. Privacy boundary: do not include the full postcode.

net_import_kw.description: Net power import at the grid connection point. Positive = importing from grid, negative = exporting to grid. Units: kW.

price_signal_seen.description: The buy price or tariff signal ($/MWh) used by the optimiser as its import objective function input for this interval. May be spot RRP, TOU tariff midpoint, or broker signal.

price_export_seen.description: The sell price or feed-in tariff signal ($/MWh) seen by the optimiser for this interval. Sign: positive = paid for exports, negative = paying to export (negative feed-in tariff event). Captures the asymmetry between buy and sell price critical for accurate counterfactual computation.

optimiser_setpoint_kw.description: The setpoint (kW) commanded by the optimiser for this interval. Same sign convention as net_import_kw.

flex_available_up_kw.description: Upward flexibility available (kW): additional load the household could absorb right now. Must be non-negative. If HAEO does not expose this directly, derived from battery max charge rate minus current setpoint.

flex_available_down_kw.description: Downward flexibility available (kW): load reduction or export increase the household could deliver right now. Must be non-negative. If HAEO does not expose this directly, derived from battery max discharge rate minus current setpoint.

storage_soc_pct.description: Battery state of charge as a percentage (0-100). Report 0 if no battery is present.

envelope_import_limit_kw.description: Maximum import allowed at this moment (kW), as tracked by the optimiser. May originate from DNSP export management, network constraint, inverter firmware, or tariff structure.

envelope_export_limit_kw.description: Maximum export allowed at this moment (kW). Positive number representing the magnitude of allowed export flow.

naive_baseline_kw.description: Estimated consumption (kW) without optimisation. The receipts field: enables ex-post verification of demand response. Same sign convention as net_import_kw.
